assembly.description: Id of the loaded assembly that is the type's module build.

token.description: TypeDef token, for get_type_info / decompile_member with assembly.

buildCheck.description: match, mismatch (the loaded assembly of that name is another build) or unknown.

value.description: A string's value, or a boxed primitive's.

path.description: Field name, dotted for fields of expanded references and structs; [i] for array elements.

value.description: Primitive value, quoted string, null, or the array length; absent for objects and structs (see Address).

address.description: Address of the referenced object (dump_object) or of an inline struct.

truncated.description: More fields or elements exist than maxFields / maxArrayItems allowed.
